caption: ReleaseProof — proof before permission. Actual recorded NVIDIA calls on Nebius; the review-all contract is distinct from the original policy.
Architecture: reserve before inference, bind approval to exact evidence, and revalidate every action. Actual Pollard, Hashrope, and Epicormic dependencies.
Measured local results. Original-policy candidates stayed blocked; Super passed under a separate policy requiring human review for every draft.
Recorded live public-browser qualification: Super + prompt v2 + review-all policy, 16/16. The adjacent Lightning run has a different policy.
Actual live held-out issue: label, route, and a draft marked Needs review. Nothing was sent to a customer or external issue tracker.
Recorded server refusal after the tools contract changed: the old approval could not authorize another action. Board unchanged; no new model call.
Recorded budget evidence: reserve conservative call cost, reconcile provider usage, and preserve recovery capacity. Token costs are estimates.
Controlled synthetic drift: real Epicormic statistics, 80 observations, p=0.001, and a hold. Separate live probe: p=1, with low statistical power.
